previousBulletins: Salt is dear again. The Tannerfolk say the Hollow Spire lot burned two of their drying racks, and the pirates say nothing, which is how pirates say yes. Elsewhere, a Glimmer Coast caravan is on the move with more guards than goods, which tells you all you need to know about the roads.

The salt flats remain contested and the salt remains expensive. Readers wishing to avoid both are advised to stay inland. The Glimmer Coast Company reports a profitable week; the Company always reports a profitable week.
